revision_audit.change_verification: Parsed comparison confirms ONLY FS-0007 direction 3 and FS-0008 directions changed. No supplement header, ID, category or basis change. All 16 target objects and all other 10 bound input files match the prior completed review. Current target and neighboring guides, plus slick-back and crew-cut staging/field reviews, were read directly for this reassessment.

prior_rejections.reason: The first two directions add useful person-relative part-side and independent volume/ear controls, but direction 3 calls the excluded finish the slick-back wet finish. That characterization is not established by its cited basis. A blanket proposal label cannot repair an inaccurate description of the collected concept.

Direction 2 says to preserve this entry's forward-flowing fringe, but the actual target specifies only short fringe, matte texture and tidy sides. Forward flow is neither an existing target invariant nor a fact in the cited crew-cut fields. Directions 1-2 then largely repeat the existing French-crop/Caesar guidance; saying not to create duplicates does not resolve that semantic overlap.

revision_audit.decision_basis: Both earlier rejections stand for the previous SHA. The new SHA removes the unsupported wet-finish characterization and the inherited forward-flow assertion, and adds a concrete texture comparison while preserving the actual target constraints. New acceptance is based on these inspected edits, not a request to reverse decisions.

scope: DB entries and descriptions only. None of the supplement directions are verified web facts, media, acquired/reviewed images, or new entries. Acceptance covers only separately labeled creative-description enrichment of the specified existing ID; it does not approve application, new verified-concept counts, or replacement of existing target constraints.

independence.role: Independent child reviewer; not supplement author
independence.method: Read the gap-fill plan, all 16 complete target records, all 47 hair and 42 makeup titles/descriptions and detail keys, close-neighbor full guidance, all 20 distinct cited staging concept records and their field/source review facts, plus hair/makeup accepted snapshots. No draft decision was presumed correct.
independence.source_access: Local JSON text only. This audit assesses logical use of previously approved facts; it does not independently re-open or re-verify external primary sources.
independence.side_effects: Only data/web-research/creative-supplement-review.json is written. No subagents, commits, paid services, media access, remote writes, staging/review edits, normalized-output edits or pipeline edits.

concurrency.note: All 11 current input files were snapshotted for this revision review. Only the supplement differs from the prior completed review; no input changed during the current read comparisons. The earlier concurrent database update remains accounted for by its current hash and the prior review history; all targets are unchanged. These are point-in-time bindings, not a lock against later DAG writes.

semantic_uniqueness_summary: No proposal creates a new ID. Existing overlaps remain pre-existing and must not be counted as newly distinct concepts: especially low buns, matte skin and short beard/stubble. Added state/comparison metadata can enrich an existing ID without certifying that the underlying category inventory is duplicate-free. Revised FS-0008 adds a same-length bundle-thickness/spacing comparison and leaves fringe direction explicitly unspecified; it no longer claims a forward-flow invariant or merely repeats neighboring crop definitions.
factual_boundary_summary: Global proposal/authorship/basis_policy labels are necessary and must travel with accepted text. Product claims, numeric source instructions and source-specific tutorial geometry are not generalized or promoted. No rejected butterfly-cut or bixie-cut fact is used. Revised FS-0007 no longer attributes wetness to slick-back; revised FS-0008 labels texture and direction choices as creative, not collected facts. No direction becomes a verified fact, media item or new entry.
